description: NovaMind AI is a virtual multidisciplinary team for NASA Space Apps 2026. We aim to build an interactive AI-powered dashboard for the “Flame in Freefall” challenge, transforming microgravity combustion data into clear fire-safety insights for future Moon and Mars missions. We welcome teammates skilled in AI/ML, data science, software, web development, UI/UX, and space science.
summary: NovaMind AI is an interactive dashboard that transforms NASA's FLEX microgravity combustion data into actionable fire-safety insights. It allows users to explore 275 experiments, compare microgravity vs Earth gravity, and rank experiments based on fire-safety relevance, making complex space science accessible and auditable.
details: Fire behaves fundamentally differently in microgravity than it does on Earth. Understanding these differences is critical for protecting astronauts and ensuring fire safety during future space missions. Our solution, NovaMind AI, addresses the "Flame in Freefall" challenge by transforming complex NASA datasets into understandable scientific insights. We built an interactive dashboard using Python and Streamlit that allows users to explore the NASA PSI-69 (Flame Extinguishment Experiment - FLEX) dataset. Key Features: NASA Data Explorer (Filter 275 experiments), Interactive Visualizations (compare µg vs 1g), Fire Safety Insights (auto-generated, evidence-cited), and Experiment Ranking (transparent, user-weighted composite score). By making NASA's open data accessible and auditable, NovaMind AI empowers researchers and space enthusiasts to better understand fire behavior in space, contributing to safer human space exploration.
